research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Attabotics is researching and developing a multi-zone automated storage and retrieval system, focusing on methods for controlling robotic storage and retrieval vehicles within isolated storage zones. Additionally, they are working on storage and retrieval systems where bins are arranged in a three-dimensional grid, with each cell featuring a central void to facilitate efficient movement and access. These areas reflect their focus on robotic warehousing and automated fulfillment solutions.

product.name: Attabotics Storage System
product.description: An intelligent 3D cube-based automated storage and retrieval system (ASRS) that uses robotic shuttles to store and retrieve goods, increasing warehouse capacity, throughput, and order-fulfillment accuracy.

product.name: Warehouse Automation Integration and Support
product.description: Implementation and operational support for integrating Attabotics robotic storage systems with existing warehouse processes, infrastructure, and manual or automated fulfillment operations.
